name: local-llm
about: Run open-weight LLMs on this workspace's GPU, or on its CPU when no NVIDIA GPU is usable (x86 GPU: llama.cpp, ik_llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, TabbyAPI, LM Studio for internal use only; NVIDIA DGX Spark: llama.cpp on unified memory, vLLM as an experimental opt-in; CPU: llama.cpp); weights download only on Run
description: Runs open-source LLMs on this machine's GPU, or on its CPU when no NVIDIA GPU is usable (a Mac through its Podman machine, a server without a GPU, or a host whose GPU is not granted). On x86 hosts with a GPU of its own: llama.cpp, ik_llama.cpp or Ollama, and vLLM or TabbyAPI once an admin installs them. On NVIDIA DGX Spark (arm64, GB10, memory shared with the system): llama.cpp, for the listed models and models added at run time, sized by estimate against the shared memory pool and watched by a memory guard; vLLM is experimental there and stays off unless the operator sets ploinky var LOCAL_LLM_VLLM_UNIFIED experimental and an admin installs it. LM Studio is proprietary and for internal use only: it stays off unless the deployment's operator sets ploinky var LOCAL_LLM_LMSTUDIO internal-use and restarts local-llm, and an admin must then accept its Terms to install it. Admins pick a model and a runner in Settings; weights download only when Run is pressed. Its manifest declares GPU access (containerSecurity.gpu); on the host, ploinky gpu revoke --agent local-llms/local-llm takes it away and ploinky gpu grant --agent local-llms/local-llm restores it.

capabilities.summary: Serves the open-weight model an administrator runs on this workspace's GPU or CPU.
capabilities.whenToUse: Call soul_gateway/local-llms/local-llm/default for private, on-machine generation once a model is ready; it answers 503 not_ready otherwise.
